body: Built for off-grid travel and long-distance adventure, this 2023 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD camper van in the El Capitan build tier includes premium power, solar, air conditioning, diesel heat, a full kitchen, tiled indoor shower, large water system, queen bed, and rugged exterior upgrades.

Inside, the van features a warm modern interior with a Natural Oak slat ceiling, painted shiplap walls, luxury vinyl flooring, custom tile, a queen bed layout, smart storage, and premium lighting designed for comfortable life on the road.
